children: First Community announced 2Q26 results and a planned bank leadership transition, and highlighted the completed Signature Bank of Georgia acquisition and related financial impacts.
Furnished investor presentation for Raymond James Bank & Banking on Tech conference Sept 9-10, 2026, as Exhibit 99.1.
Announced CEO/President of First Community Bank J. Ted Nissen to retire Dec 31, 2026; Vaughan Dozier to become CEO and Drew Painter to become President effective Jan 1, 2027.
Closed Signature Bank of Georgia acquisition Jan 8, 2026; systems converted Mar 13, 2026, adding GGL/SBA lines and Atlanta market presence.
Reported $2.4bn total assets and 23 banking offices as of June 30, 2026; noted loan growth (11.0% YTD annualized) and NIM expansion over nine quarters.
Board approved dividend increase to $0.17/sh, payable Aug 18, 2026; share repurchase plan up to $7.5m announced May 7, 2026.
